title: Turn your site into a place people can bump into each other
summary: TownSquare is a lightweight presence layer for websites that enables visitors to see each other in real-time, creating opportunities for spontaneous interaction and community building directly on web pages.
problem_solved: It addresses the isolated nature of websites by letting visitors discover and potentially connect with others currently browsing the same site.
why_valuable: It transforms passive browsing into a more social experience, making websites feel like shared spaces where serendipitous encounters can happen, similar to bumping into someone at a physical venue.
